de: During the Seven Years' War the leading burghers of Königsberg submit to Elizabeth of Russia, thus forming Russian Prussia (until 1763).

te: The Marathas defeat the Afghans in the Battle of Attock and capture the city.
dz: 马拉地斯人在阿托克战役中击败了阿富汗人并攻克了该城.

de: Ten-year-old Mary Campbell is abducted in Pennsylvania by Lenape during the French and Indian War. She is returned six and a half years later.

te: Battle of Krefeld: British, Hanoverian, and Prussian forces defeat French troops at Krefeld in Germany.
dz: 七年战争：克雷菲尔德战役：英国、汉诺威和普鲁士军队在德国克雷菲尔德击败法国军队。
de: Seven Years' War: Battle of Krefeld: British, Hanoverian, and Prussian forces defeat French troops at Krefeld in Germany.

te: Habsburg Austrian forces destroy a Prussian reinforcement and supply convoy in the Battle of Domstadtl, helping to expe…
dz: 七年战争：哈布斯堡奥地利军队在多姆施塔特战役中摧毁了一支普鲁士增援和补给车队，帮助将普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝驱逐出摩拉维亚。
de: Seven Years' War: Habsburg Austrian forces destroy a Prussian reinforcement and supply convoy in the Battle of Domstadtl, helping to expel Prussian King Frederick the Great from Moravia.

dz: 法军将卡里隆要塞控制在纽约的蒂康德罗加与英军对峙.

t: 路易斯堡围攻以英国军队击败法国并控制圣劳伦斯湾而结束。
te: The Siege of Louisbourg ends with British forces defeating the French and taking control of the Gulf of Saint Lawrence.
dz: 法国和印度战争：路易斯堡围攻以英国军队击败法国并控制圣劳伦斯湾而结束。
de: French and Indian War: The Siege of Louisbourg ends with British forces defeating the French and taking control of the Gulf of Saint Lawrence.

dz: 七年战争：普鲁士腓特烈二世在佐恩多夫战役中击败俄罗斯军队。

te: The Treaty of Easton establishes the first American Indian reservation, at Indian Mills, New Jersey, for the Lenape.
dz: 《伊斯顿条约》在新泽西州印第安米尔斯为莱纳佩人建立了第一个美国印第安人保留地.

t: 法国在七年战争中击退了英国的入侵.

dz: 圣卡斯特战役:法国在七年战争中击退了英国的入侵.

te: British forces capture Fort Duquesne from French control. Later, Fort Pitt will be built nearby and grow into modern Pi…
dz: 法国与印第安人战争：英军从法军手中夺取杜肯堡。此后，皮特堡将在附近建成，并逐渐发展为今天的匹兹堡。
de: French and Indian War: British forces capture Fort Duquesne from French control. Later, Fort Pitt will be built nearby and grow into modern Pittsburgh.

te: The English transport ship Duke William sinks in the North Atlantic, killing over 360 people.
dz: 英国运输船威廉公爵号在北大西洋下沉,造成360多人死亡.
de: The English transport ship Duke William sinks in the North Atlantic, killing over 360 people.

te: Halley's Comet is sighted by Johann Georg Palitzsch, confirming Edmund Halley's prediction of its passage. This was the…
dz: 哈利彗星被约翰·格奥尔格·帕利茨克所看见,证实了埃德蒙·哈利对彗星的通过所作的预测. 这是提前预言的彗星的第一段经过.
de: Halley's Comet is sighted by Johann Georg Palitzsch, confirming Edmund Halley's prediction of its passage.  This was the first passage of a comet predicted ahead of time.
